title: ddalggak session state
description: Single source of truth for ddalggak session state. `.ddalggak/session-state.json` must satisfy this schema; `phase_ledger.phases[]` is the canonical multi-phase progression record, while `phase_ledger.current_phase_id` and top-level `phase` are projections that must agree. `templates/conductor-state.md` and `templates/lane-state.md` are markdown projections of it (conductor sections map to the top-level fields, lane-state Event Record maps to one `lanes[]` entry). Validated by `ddalggak status --local` with the zero-dependency subset validator in bin/lib/status/session-state.mjs: local $ref, type, const, enum, required, properties, items, format=date-time.

templates/conductor-state.md.Issues / PRs / Branches: lanes[] (Issue -> lanes[].issue, Branch -> lanes[].branch.name, Worktree -> lanes[].branch.worktree, PR -> lanes[].pull_request.url, State -> lanes[].state)
templates/conductor-state.md.Phase Ledger: phase_ledger (phases[] is canonical; current_phase_id is a checked projection)

nextGate.description: Next safe gate contract for session-level and lane-level progress. `owner` is the responsible actor; `action` names the next action in short, stable wording; `command` records the exact command when applicable; `exit_condition` records the observable signal that releases this gate. `action`, `command`, and `exit_condition` intentionally remain strings because gate wording is an operational breadcrumb, not an execution enum.

action.description: Short stable action phrase, e.g. create_pr, wait_for_checks, run_review, fix_blockers, request_human_decision, or merge_manual_only.

command.description: Exact command to run when the next gate is command-driven; empty string when the next step is human/manual or not a shell command.

exit_condition.description: Observable completion signal for leaving the gate, e.g. PR URL read back, checks terminal success/skipped, APPROVE evidence at current head, human answer posted, or manual merge verified.

evidence.description: Audit references required for completed and skipped phases; skipped evidence records the reason or decision artifact.

attempt_count.description: Monotonic number of times this phase entered in_progress. Runtime writers initialize the first active attempt to 1 and increment blocked-to-in_progress retries.

phases.description: Canonical phase graph. Exactly one phase must be the graph terminal with next_phase_id null; array order is not semantic.

schema.description: Schema identity tag for forward-compatible migration.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last state write. Drives the stale judgment: older than x-ddalggak.staleAfterHours means the file must not be trusted for resume decisions.

revision.description: Monotonic optimistic-concurrency revision maintained by `ddalggak state`. Optional for backward-compatible read-only state; required by the deterministic writer.

last_transition.description: Last applied transition id and canonical request hash for exact idempotent replay.

phase.description: Current phase or wave name. Conductor-state projection: `## Phase`.

base_branch.description: Base branch PRs target, e.g. master.

lanes.description: One entry per implementation lane. Conductor-state projection: `## Issues / PRs / Branches` table rows; lane-state Event Record maps to one entry.

state.description: Lane lifecycle state; values and transitions are defined in templates/lane-state.md.

final_verdict.description: Review Quality Contract v2 verdict. Separate from the GitHub formal-review conclusion axis.

validation_evidence.description: Session-level validation evidence lines. Conductor-state projection: `## Validation Evidence`.

blocking_gaps.description: Session-level blockers. Conductor-state projection: `## Blocking Gaps`.

waiting_on.description: What the session is currently waiting on (human decision, external job, merge).
